module_summary: PS/2-style packet framer: a 4-state FSM syncs on in[3] to count three bytes while a 24-bit shift register captures them, output when done.

anchors.name: out_bytes_r
anchors.why: 24-bit shift register holding the last three input bytes.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse marking out_bytes valid after third byte.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Input byte stream shifted into out_bytes_r; bit 3 drives framing.

groups.name: Framing controller
groups.description: FSM locating message boundaries and pulsing done.

groups.name: Byte shift datapath
groups.description: Three-byte shift register exposed on out_bytes when done.
